text:
Posted by Hugh Holland on January 7, 2019 at 12:24 pm VeriSign, Inc. (NASDAQ:VRSN) Ratings Coverage
Among 3 analysts covering VeriSign ( NASDAQ:VRSN ), 1 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 2 Hold. Therefore 33% are positive. VeriSign had 4 analyst reports since July 27, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. Citigroup maintained VeriSign, Inc. (NASDAQ:VRSN) rating on Friday, November 2. Citigroup has “Neutral” rating and $155 target. Robert W. Baird upgraded VeriSign, Inc. (NASDAQ:VRSN) on Friday, November 2 to “Outperform” rating. The stock has “Neutral” rating by JP Morgan on Friday, November 2. The stock has “Underweight” rating by JP Morgan on Friday, July 27. The stock increased 4.47% or $6.38 during the last trading session, reaching $148.97. About 789,329 shares traded. VeriSign, Inc. (NASDAQ:VRSN) has risen 39.16% since January 7, 2018 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 39.16% the S&P500.
VeriSign, Inc. provides domain name registry services and Internet security worldwide. The company has market cap of $18.01 billion. The firm offers registry services that operate the authoritative directory of .com, .net, .cc, .tv, and .name domain names, as well as the back-end systems for .gov, .jobs, .edu, and other domain names. It has a 36.53 P/E ratio. The Company’s registry services allow individuals and organizations to establish their online identities.
